head: Galaxy Z TriFold 2 leak: codename hints at few markets again
dek: Dutch site GalaxyClub reports the second tri-fold phone's codename is Q9m and suspects it will again reach only a few markets, possibly not Europe, Android Authority says. Samsung hasn't confirmed it.
details: The codename follows the first TriFold's Q7m and the Fold Special Edition's Q6a, and neither of those launched worldwide. The first Galaxy Z TriFold cost $2,899, sold in small numbers in a handful of markets and was discontinued months after launch. Earlier reports said Samsung plans to make many more TriFold 2 units in 2027, which doesn't mean more countries. Samsung's next foldables aren't expected before summer 2027.
where: Not confirmed; Samsung's next foldables are expected in summer 2027
means: If you'd want the TriFold 2 in Europe or another market that missed the first one, it may be hard to get again.
